main_text.p: 3. Porrò,cur tádem in Ecclesiæ societate, è mūdo selecti,à Domino cooptamur, si ab ea potisimùm incipit Dei iudiciu,& ea est instar gregis ouium in medio luporum? Itáne ad summas & acerbissimas miserias folùm uocamur & ducimur?

4. Quoties autem,& quàm longo tempore ueritatis lux,mendaciorum sophismatumq; caligine & nebulis obscurata est,& prope exstincta? Nihil iam dicam de Cimmerijs illis tenebris,quas inuexit Antichristianismus Pontificius: bone Deus, quam nūc tempestatem excitant, fontes aqua carentes, & nebulæ à turbine agitatæ,ij inquam,qui uerbis quidem gloriantur se esse uindices maiestatis Filij hominis, reuera autem pernegant eū in carne uenisse? 2.Pet.2.17. 1.Ioan.4.3.

5. Iam uerò, quis non uideat, infinita fere, Deoq; summè exofa scelera, à diabolis eorumque organis & satellitibus perpetrari: nec, nisi admodum raro, ea fieri, quæ & Deo grata, & hominibus salutaria sunt?

page.notes: Line 3 "societate" is split across two printed lines without a hyphen, so it is written whole. "lupo rum" and "tem pore" are likewise split without a hyphen and written whole. "Ioan" and "Pet" references are as printed. The paragraph ends on the hyphenated "impro-", which continues on the next page. Spelling such as "potisimùm", "tádem", "exofa" and "summè" is kept as printed.
